guard: focus-mode cotal_inbox returns each body exactly once when stream recall cannot return it, while replay-on concrete traffic stays stream-recalled
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-core build && pnpm smoke:focus-recall-loss
why: The suite drives a real isolated JetStream broker and the public cotal_inbox tool spec, not a stub. Its replay-on concrete control proves the stream-recall instrument returns ambient and mentions; its two claim arms prove replay-off concrete and wildcard-only focus traffic are delivered exactly once through the local pull-only lane.

Every mutation is compile-clean and aimed at one load-bearing boundary. Reverting the ingest choice restores the filed silent loss. Treating wildcard coverage as concrete restores wildcard loss only. Guessing the cached policy as true destroys replay-off bodies. Removing the pull-only protection lets a late durable copy change delivery class. Removing focus exclusion allows duplication if policy changes after receive.
The command rebuilds core and connector-core before every run because the workspace resolves package imports through dist. A source mutation without a build is a mutation the suite never executed.

mutations.name: restore unconditional focus ack-drop
mutations.find: const recallable = item.channel !== undefined && await this.ep.focusRecallable(item.channel);
mutations.expectRed: replay-off body must be returned or loss reported

mutations.name: treat wildcard coverage as a concrete join
mutations.expectRed: wildcard body must be returned or loss reported

mutations.name: guess replay true instead of reading the registry
mutations.expectRed: replay-off body must be returned or loss reported
